# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.6 Module 3: Civilization Regencies, Heir Educations & Designated Heir Reasons (oe_reg_). Generated by gen_v96_regency_edu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# File prefix 05_ sorts strictly after vanilla 00_* special successions and before 1_nobles_regency.txt.
# All 5 civilization regency triggers are strictly mutually exclusive (zero overlap).

oe_reg_byz_porphyrogenitus_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
		}
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		has_consort = yes
		has_heir = yes
		consort ?= {
			is_adult = yes
			modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
		}
		NOR = {
			is_at_war_with = heir.employer
			is_at_war_with = consort.employer
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.10
		stability_investment = small_stability_investment
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.5
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg_active_type value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = root.consort }
			set_regent = root.consort
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:crown_estate
					age = 38
					female = yes
					adm = 55
					dip = 60
					mil = 40
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.1 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg_active_type
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_reg_porphyrogenitus_coronation
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				has_ruler = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_reg_heir_charter_cd }
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.10 days = 5 }
		}
	}
}

oe_reg_byz_senate_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
		}
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				has_consort = yes
				has_heir = yes
				consort ?= {
					is_adult = yes
					modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
				}
				NOR = {
					is_at_war_with = heir.employer
					is_at_war_with = consort.employer
				}
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.08
		legislative_efficiency = 0.10
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.05
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.05
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg_active_type value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					OR = {
						has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
						has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					}
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					OR = {
						has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
						has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					}
				}
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = religion:orthodox
					estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					age = 48
					female = no
					adm = 65
					dip = 55
					mil = 45
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.2 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg_active_type
		}
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:nobles_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_reg_senate_stewardship_legacy
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				has_ruler = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_reg_heir_charter_cd }
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.10 days = 5 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

oe_reg_yuan_kurultai_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			tag = CHI
			tag = YUA
			tag = GLH
			tag = WHO
			tag = TIM
		}
		OR = {
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			government_type = government_type:steppe_horde
		}
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				OR = {
					tag = CHI
					tag = YUA
				}
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				has_consort = yes
				consort ?= {
					is_adult = yes
					modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
				}
				NOT = { is_at_war_with = consort.employer }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		army_light_cavalry_power = 0.08
		army_heavy_cavalry_power = 0.06
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_permanent_target_satisfaction
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.10
		monthly_towards_decentralization = societal_value_monthly_move
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg_active_type value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = previous_ruler
				previous_ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_dynasty = yes
					dynasty = root.previous_ruler.dynasty
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_dynasty = yes
					dynasty = root.previous_ruler.dynasty
				}
				order_by = mil
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				}
				order_by = mil
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = previous_ruler
						previous_ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
					}
					create_character = {
						culture = root.culture
						religion = root.religion
						estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
						dynasty = root.previous_ruler.dynasty
						age = 42
						female = no
						adm = 45
						dip = 50
						mil = 70
						save_scope_as = new_leader
					}
				}
				else = {
					create_character = {
						culture = root.culture
						religion = root.religion
						estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
						age = 42
						female = no
						adm = 45
						dip = 50
						mil = 70
						save_scope_as = new_leader
					}
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.4 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg_active_type
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.6 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

oe_reg_rus_boyar_duma_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = MOS
			has_or_had_tag = RUS
			has_or_had_tag = NOV
			has_or_had_tag = TVE
			has_or_had_tag = RYA
		}
		NOR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			tag = CHI
			tag = YUA
			tag = GLH
			tag = WHO
			tag = TIM
		}
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
	}

	modifier = {
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_permanent_target_satisfaction
		global_defensive = 0.08
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.04
		monthly_towards_aristocracy = societal_value_monthly_move
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg_active_type value = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					religion = religion:orthodox
				}
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					religion = religion:orthodox
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					religion ?= religion:orthodox
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					religion = religion:orthodox
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = culture:muscovite
					religion = religion:orthodox
					estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					age = 46
					female = no
					adm = 55
					dip = 55
					mil = 60
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.5 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg_active_type
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.7 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
